name: UnADF
runtimeDependencies: AmigaOS 3.0 or later and a 68020 or later, with 2 MiB of Fast RAM recommended
xfdmaster.library for optional compressed ADF input
notes: The Aminet archive supplies both the Shell command and the English readme. BCWB ships no command icon or saved settings.
Directory Opus invokes UnADF for listing and extraction. Its configuration keeps its current owner. The shared xfdmaster.library is outside this package.
